notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.14
notes.content:
ADDED

Added translations: German, French, Spanish
Added the ability to turn on the inversion of the view
Added the ability to disable camera swinging left/right
Added the ability to disable camera shaking
Added subtitles to the intro


IMPROVED

Reduced use of the game's RAM
Reduced the weight of the game from 7.42GB to 5.5GB
Optimized player animations


FIXED

Fixed the AI getting stuck in the floor
Fixed the gate to the Warehouse location where it was possible to fall under the map
Fixed a badly shaking camera at a time when the player often jumped and rested against the ceiling
Fixed a place in Sector A where you could get stuck
Fixed errors caused when interacting with buttons, keyboards, walkie-talkie
Fixed the sequence of completing the task in Sector A about taking a flashlight and listening to a message from a walkie-talkie
Fixed the HUD of the slot machine, which was shown when the player was in the car
Fixed the ability to shoot in the car
Fixed boxes whose decals could pass through objects
Possible fix for game crashes


MINOR CHANGES

Localization amendments
Language change moved to settings

notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.13
notes.content:
ADDED

Added pistol
Added camera tilt when walking left/right
Added the effect of disappearing dead enemies
Added Fidelity FX 1.0
Added the ability to disable: crosshair, HUD, subtitles
Added volume setting for: music, player steps


IMPROVED

Complete rework of sewer level
Changed the sounds of walking on all surfaces


FIXED

Fixed glowing surfaces due to anti-aliasing on all graphics settings
Fixed the hands, rifle, which could be covered with decals
Fixed settings buttons that were in the wrong position
Fixed car skid
Fixed place, near the shooting range, where bullets could hit an invisible obstacle
Fixed final level optimization
Fixed disappearing pipe in Sector A
Minor fixes on maps


MINOR CHANGES

Now, when entering the car, the camera will be in the first person, not in the third
Maximum vehicle speed has been reduced
Now the initial cut-scene can be skipped by pressing the space bar after 3 seconds
Reduced the size of the bullet hole decal
Now if the main character dies, the enemies will stop attacking him
The demon near of the shooting range appears more logically
Now the red eye of robots is turned off after death
Increased texture quality size for wood planks
Now the background of the main menu is not played on pause

notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.12
notes.content:
ADDED

 Added translation for wall maps and papers for russian language


IMPROVED

 Improved lighting after turning on generators in Sector A


FIXED

 Fixed inspection of notes, now the standard zoom is not too strong
 Fixed the texture of the backpack, now it will not load slowly

notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.11
notes.content:
ADDED

Added input settings
Added partial gamepad support
Added new hand models
https://media.giphy.com/media/7UjLoJfRgjx86IAhZm/giphy.gif
Added recoil to weapons
Added a reload animation, in which the player, if not spent all the ammo, will reload the rifle without hitting the latch
Added more widgets on levels
Added a view from the camera to one of the monitors in the sewer.
Added 1 first aid kit in the sewer, 1 first aid kit in sector B
Added 2 wall maps in warehouse
Added setting for the quality of "Effects"
Added a new achievement "SWITCH"


IMPROVED

Changed the system of damage from the bullets to opponents:

Common demon and robots:
 * One bullet dies in the head
 * In the body from 3 bullets
 * At feet from 5 bullets
 * In the hands of 6 bullets

Big Demon:
 * Head from 4 bullets
 * In the body from 10 bullets
 * At feet from 15 bullets
 * In the hands of 20 bullets

 * If the hit is in the hand or foot, the enemy will not take damage

Improved visualization of widgets
Improved the visibility of the crosshair when the player hovers over an object that can be interacted with
Improved reload sound sync with animation
Changed loading screen


FIXED

Fixed the light from the flashlight, which, after turning on the pause, could degrade the quality of the light itself
Fixed fences, now you can shoot through them
Fixed the limbs of demons that were twisting after death
Fixed "YOU ARE HERE" pointer on wall maps
Changed the position of the inscription "POWER", in sector A, so that the player does not experience difficulties in finding this room
Fixed a light bulb near the computer in the sewer
Fixed the initial splash screen where it was possible to turn on the inventory
Fixed introductory text at low resolutions
Fixed wall in sector A



MINOR CHANGES

Changed the position of the inscription "POWER", in sector A, so that the player does not experience difficulties in finding this room
Increased the speed of the character on the stairs
Removed the ability to lean
Removed the ability to inspect items
Changed saving in the dining room before the emergency opening of the gate

notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you to all those who supported my game with purchase and words! Here is a list of corrections in the game. I hope You enjoy the update, I tried my best!


1.1

-Added level schemes to improve player orientation

https://media2.giphy.com/media/Y2nzt1mY2E6t0MlfUz/giphy.gif

-Added inscriptions on the "Hangar" level, to improve orientation
-Added translation of the text "Saving" (Russian)
-Added a objective in the final
-Added a new room in "Sector B", location "Transit"

-Improved final location
-Improved office location
-Improved flashlight pickup hitbox
-Improved weapon pickup hitbox
-Improved ammo pickup hitbox
-Improved medkit pickup hitbox
-Improved objectives for 3 locations

-Fixed the electric door at the Hangar location, which after loading the save was opened without a keycard
(If you have this door closed after loading the save, and you opened it earlier, you will have to load the save before opening this door(old saves))
-Fixed walls in the final location
-Fixed walls in the office location
-Fixed ceiling and walls in Sector A
-Fixed a light bulb at the sewer level
-Fixed doors that were using the wrong effect when hit by a bullet in the sewer and warehouse levels
-Fixed stone texture that was using the wrong effect when hit by a bullet in the final level
-Fixed part of the box that was visible through the plywood
-Fixed sound of fan propellers
-Fixed flickering textures in the generator location
-Fixed decal behind the stairs in Sector A
-Fixed the music in Sector A, which, after loading, played on the entire "CERERA" complex
-Fixed a spot on the "Sewer" level that could give the player an advantage over the AI

-Removed the ability to focus on MMB
-Removed food from level 3. Too many problems with apples and muffins
-Now cones at the "Canteen" location can be poked
-Increased cursor in the center of the screen
-Changed lighting from the flashlight at the very beginning of the game
-Replaced the texture of monitors in the "Control Center" location to death screens to make it easier to find the right computer
